excerpt: Listen Labs runs AI-moderated customer interviews and analyses them for brands. Ribbit Capital led its $69 million Series B in January 2026.
content:
Listen Labs is an AI-first customer research platform. An AI interviewer runs one-to-one conversations with real people, asking follow-up questions as a human researcher would, and the platform then analyses and summarises the results: preferences between concepts, emotional reactions, ranked choices, hesitation moments and gaps between what people say and do. Its website lists uses such as pricing tests, consumer journey maps, multi-market research, brand tracking, concept and prototype testing, creative testing and usability testing, for insight teams, brand marketers, product managers, UX researchers and agencies.

Listen Labs was cofounded by Alfred Wahlforss and Florian Juengermann, according to investor Pear VC. In January 2026 it announced a $69 million Series B led by Ribbit Capital, with Evantic and existing investors Sequoia Capital, Conviction and Pear VC; Pear said that took total funding to $100 million, and Research Live reported that it followed a $27 million Series A in 2025. The company said it had grown annualised revenue fifteen-fold in nine months, had interviewed more than a million people, and counted Microsoft, Sweetgreen, Perplexity and Robinhood as customers; these figures are the company's own.

Listen Labs does not publish prices; companies book a demo. It suits research and product teams that run many studies and want results in days rather than weeks, and competes with survey and research platforms such as Qualtrics, UserTesting and Outset.

We have not used Listen Labs for this page. It brings together Listen Labs's own website and the reporting linked under Sources, and says where each fact comes from. Nothing here is paid placement.
